name: Report Header 7
definition: Specifies generic information about an investigation report.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Point to point reference as assigned by the case assigner to unambiguously identify the case status report.

From.name: From
From.definition: Party reporting the status of the investigation case.

To.name: To
To.definition: Party to which the status of the case is reported.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the message was created.
